AI code review results below, please doublecheck

No functional regression found - the accessor macros expand to the same lvalue the old code used, so every existing consumer (lgd build, pool recalc, qmt_pool_lookup) is unchanged. The concerns are about the shape of the new structure: the .md arm and the new dom_mdts list have no consumer anywhere in the tree, so the patch lands storage that nothing reads. Would it be cleaner to fold this into the patch that actually populates the DOM MDT list?

commit.subject: LU-20354 quota: add DOM MDT list to qmt_sarray
commit.message:
LU-20354 quota: add DOM MDT list to qmt_sarray

Extend qmt_sarray with a separate dom_mdts list so DT pools can
track DOM MDTs without overloading the primary tgts array used by
lgd and recalc. Primary helpers keep ignoring DOM.

Make qmt_uuid2idx() return int and output stype via pointer.

Signed-off-by: Keguang Xu <kxu@ddn.com>
Change-Id: I209b083d72156a80ad492fff8f48472230c91108
